content.text:
## Scale line My brief assigned exactly 5 points (styling hierarchy split, token discipline, duplication search, deep table/control/scroll/image a11y, AC5/AC6 responsiveness) — I ran all 5, no more, no less. I did not fan out to sub-agents: the files are few (3 primary + cross-references) and the findings interlock (e.g. the token choice for a border colour informs the focus-visibility finding), so splitting would have cost more than it saved. I did not re-run `tsc`/`lint`/`test` (gates.md: those are the lead reviewer's, not mine) — I re-ran only `node scripts/auditTokenUsage.mjs` myself, once, because a finding depended on it. I went **beyond** reading source in one respect: for the "would axe-core catch this" questions, I built a throwaway jsdom+vitest harness (this repo's own toolchain, axe-core v4.11.4 — the same version installed) and ran the actual rendered markup through `axe.run()`, then deleted the scratch files. That extra step is justified because the brief explicitly demands a yes/no answer on axe, and reasoning-from-memory about ARIA-rule internals is exactly the kind of claim this task's evidence bar exists to prevent. I did not do live-browser/Playwright verification anywhere (no browser available, stated up front, applies to every layout/overflow claim below). --- ## 1. Styling hierarchy — where does styling live vs. where the rules say it should **`zimmTable.css.ts` + `index.tsx`: clean, defensible split.** The recipe's own header comment states the intended division ("Static base styles... live here; conditional styles... applied as direct Chakra props... so branching logic stays in JSX") and the code matches it exactly: `zimmTable.css.ts` owns `textStyle`, `color: var(--zimm-color-text-default)`, `paddingX`, `tableLayout` per variant; `index.tsx` owns `borderBottom`/`borderRight`/`textAlign`/`colSpan`/`bg` as direct props because those genuinely depend on row index, column index, and variant branching that lives in JSX anyway. No bare Chakra token keys anywhere in either file — every colour/spacing reference is `var(--zimm-*)` (`overrideStyling.md` hierarchy point 2), including `BORDER_SECONDARY`/`BORDER_FOCUS`, which are correctly centralised as exported constants (imported by `sizeGuideContent.tsx`'s `GroupedSizeTable` rather than re-declared — good DRY). **No finding here** — this is the part of the PR I'd point to as the reference example. **`sizeGuideContent.tsx` has no co-located recipe at all** — everything (`NavItem`, `UnitToggle`, `GroupedSizeTable`, `ScrollableTable`, `renderTextNode`) is direct Chakra props + ad-hoc `sx`. Judged against the rules as written, this is defensible: these aren't a registered Chakra component type going through `useMultiStyleConfig`, they're one-off page-partial composition, which is exactly what hierarchy point 4 (`sx` for a one-off gap) is for. 🔵 note, not a finding: if a CM/INCH-style toggle is ever needed a second time elsewhere, it should become a real atom with its own recipe at that point, not before. ## 2. Token discipline Re-ran `node scripts/auditTokenUsage.mjs` myself in `wt113` (HEAD): **exit 1, "6 unacknowledged violation(s) found,"** listed at `footer/footer.css.ts:20`, `zimmIconAndText.css.ts:7`, `zimmProductCardMedia/index.tsx:22`, `zimmAuthDrawerContent.css.ts:66`, `zimmBenefits.css.ts:4`, `zimmDrawerShared.ts:13` — **identical set to gates.md, none in this PR's files.** Semantic-category check (colour on `color:`, background on `bg:`, border on `border-color:`) across both files: clean, no mismatches — every `color=` prop resolves a `text.*`-derived var, every `border*=` prop resolves a `border.*`-derived var. One real finding the script's own scope structurally cannot see: **`overrides/app/pages/product-detail/partials/sizeGuideContent.tsx:23`** — `const TABLET_MIN_WIDTH = '48em';`, a raw literal duplicating the registered foundation breakpoint. The file's own comment says "Mirrors foundation/gridSystem breakpoints.md" — the author knew the source and typed the value again anyway instead of importing it. I re-ran the audit script and confirm **why it didn't flag this**: `scripts/auditTokenUsage.mjs` line 10/132/139 hardcodes its scan roots to `overrides/app/components/**` and `overrides/app/theme/components/**` only (confirmed by reading the script's `SCAN_ROOTS`/`walk` logic, not just its printed "Scanned 144 files" line). `sizeGuideContent.tsx` lives under `overrides/app/pages/**` — structurally invisible to the script regardless of content. For comparison, `zimmIconAndText.css.ts:7`'s own `BP_DESKTOP = '64em'` (a directly comparable raw-em breakpoint duplicate) **is** caught by the script precisely because it lives under `overrides/app/components/`. Same mistake, different visibility, purely by file location. 🟡 should-fix, **CONFIRMED** (ran the script myself + read its scope logic), **UNIFORM** (the audit-script blind spot is real for any future `pages/` partial, not just this one). ## 3. Duplication search Grepped `overrides/app/` for the breakpoint value and the conversion constant: - **`TABLET_MIN_WIDTH = '48em'`** (point 2 above) duplicates `overrides/app/theme/foundation/gridSystem.ts:15`'s `breakpoints.md`. This is not a one-off oversight — I found **15+ other call sites** (`footer.css.ts`, `headerShared.ts`, `zimmIconAndText.css.ts`, `zimmDrawer.css.ts`, `zimmButton.css.ts`, `zimmTabs.css.ts`, `zimmProductCardShared.ts`'s `DESKTOP_QUERY`, `zimmRecentlyViewedGrid/Rail`, `megaMenuContent.css.ts`, `leftBar`/`rightBar.css.ts`, `useRecentlyViewedRailVisibleCount.ts`, `theme/index.test.tsx`) that all correctly `import { breakpoints } from 'app/theme/foundation/gridSystem'` and interpolate `${breakpoints.md}`. `footerShared.ts` is the closest structural precedent (a shared `BP.tablet = breakpoints.md` re-export specifically for files that can't consume `var()` in a media query) and this file didn't follow it. 🟡 should-fix, **CONFIRMED**, **UNIFORM** (established pattern violated by exactly one file). - **`CM_TO_INCH = 0.393701`** — searched `overrides/app/theme/` and `overrides/app/utils/` for an existing conversion constant; found none elsewhere in the codebase. This one is genuinely new, not a duplicate. Clean. - **`MIN_COL_WIDTH`**'s `calc(4xl + m)` formula — searched for the same calc pattern elsewhere; not reused anywhere else, no duplication. ## 4. Accessibility — table semantics, CM/INCH control, scroll region, fallback image, headings I built a temporary vitest+axe-core probe (this repo's own installed axe-core 4.11.4, deleted after use) rendering the actual `ZimmTable`/`SizeGuideContent` components with fixture data matching the PR's own stories, to get reproducible answers rather than guesses. **a) Row label rendered as ``, not `` — `zimmTable/index.tsx:207-209`.** ```tsx {row.label} ``` "Bust"/"Waist"/"Hips"/"Length" (and "Size"/ring sizes / belt-size labels in every real content table) are the row headers of this table, but are marked up as plain data cells.
